cases.sentence: И вот, я построю дом имени Господа, Бога ___, хотя нельзя ему войти в него.
cases.translation: And behold, I am building a house for the name of the Lord, the God of Israel, although he cannot enter it.
cases.explain: The genitive shows possession: God of whom? of Israel (Бог Израиля).

cases.sentence: И лицо Соломона стояло перед царством по всем пределам его территории в добычу из земель, которые ему подчинялись, от ___.
cases.translation: And Solomon's face was set before the kingdom throughout all its territory in tribute from the lands that were subject to him, from the boundaries to the river Euphrates.
cases.explain: от (from) governs genitive case: от границы.

cases.sentence: И Соломон собрал колесницы и конников, и было у него тысяча четыреста колесниц и двенадцать тысяч ___.
cases.translation: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen, and he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen.
cases.explain: Numbers (тысяч) govern plural genitive: двенадцать тысяч конников.

cases.translation: And Solomon settled captives in the land.
cases.explain: в (in) with location takes prepositional case: в земле.

cases.sentence: И вот, по слову Господа мне не было положено начиная дом имени Его, тем не менее, я построу ___ твоему сыну, который произойдет от чресл твоих, ему я утвержу престол его в Израиле вовеки.
cases.translation: And behold, according to the word of the Lord to me it was not permitted to build a house for his name, however, I will build a throne for your son who shall proceed from your loins; I will establish his throne in Israel forever.
cases.explain: The transitive verb утвержу (I will establish) requires accusative case for its object.

cases.sentence: И Соломон завершил постройку дома Господа и свой ___.
cases.translation: And Solomon finished building the house of the Lord and his own house.
cases.explain: завершил (finished) is transitive and takes accusative: завершил дом.

cases.sentence: И пошел Соломон в Хамаф-Цова, и завладел ею из руки царя в пустыне, при помощи ___ его.
cases.translation: And Solomon went to Hamath-Zobah and captured it, and took it from the hand of the king in the wilderness, with the help of his army.
cases.explain: при помощи (with the help of) takes instrumental case.

cases.sentence: И построил он Пальмиру в пустыне и все ___ для хранилищ в земле Иудеи.
cases.translation: And he built Palmyra in the wilderness and all the cities for storage in the land of Judah.
cases.explain: все (all) with plural noun takes genitive: все города.

reading.ru: И вот, я построю дом имени Господа, Бога Израиля, хотя нельзя ему войти в него.
reading.question: What does Solomon say about building a house for the Lord?
options: He will build a house for the name of the Lord, God of Israel, although it cannot contain Him
reading.correct: He will build a house for the name of the Lord, God of Israel, although it cannot contain Him
reading.explain: Solomon states 'я построю дом имени Господа, Бога Израиля, хотя нельзя ему войти в него' (I will build a house for the name of the Lord, God of Israel, although it cannot contain Him).

reading.ru: И Соломон собрал колесницы и конников, и было у него тысяча четыреста колесниц и двенадцать тысяч конников.
reading.question: What military forces did Solomon gather?
options: Five hundred chariots and five thousand horsemen
Fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen
Two thousand chariots and ten thousand horsemen
One thousand chariots and eight thousand horsemen
reading.correct: Fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen
reading.explain: The text states 'тысяча четыреста колесниц и двенадцать тысяч конников' (fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen).

reading.ru: И поселил Соломон данников в земле.
reading.question: What did Solomon do with the captives?
options: He settled them in the land
He made them slaves in Egypt
He left them in the desert
reading.correct: He settled them in the land
reading.explain: The text says 'поселил Соломон данников в земле' (Solomon settled the captives in the land).

reading.ru: И вот, по слову Господа мне не было положено начиная дом имени Его, тем не менее, я построю престол твоему сыну.
reading.question: What did the Lord say about who would build the temple?
options: According to the Lord's word, Solomon was not permitted to build the house, but he would build a throne for his son
The temple should not be built at all
reading.correct: According to the Lord's word, Solomon was not permitted to build the house, but he would build a throne for his son
reading.explain: The text explains 'по слову Господа мне не было положено начиная дом имени Его, тем не менее, я построю престол твоему сыну' (According to the Lord's word, I was not permitted to build the house, but I will build a throne for your son).

reading.ru: И Соломон завершил постройку дома Господа и своего дома.
reading.question: What did Solomon complete?
options: Only the temple of the Lord
The temple of the Lord and his own house
reading.correct: The temple of the Lord and his own house
reading.explain: The text states 'Соломон завершил постройку дома Господа и своего дома' (Solomon finished building the house of the Lord and his own house).

reading.ru: И пошел Соломон в Хамаф-Цова, и завладел ею из руки царя в пустыне.
reading.question: Where did Solomon go and what did he do there?
options: He went to Egypt and built cities
He went to Hamath-Zobah and captured it
He went to the sea and built ships
He went to Tyre to trade
reading.correct: He went to Hamath-Zobah and captured it
reading.explain: The text says 'пошел Соломон в Хамаф-Цова, и завладел ею' (Solomon went to Hamath-Zobah and captured it).
